facts.fact: SPIN (Gabon) reports that the partners signed a memorandum of understanding and a confidentiality agreement on CAB-CORRIDOR, a terrestrial interconnection between Cameroon, Gabon and the Republic of Congo over the Central African Backbone, with implementation modalities due in October 2026; signing dates are not given, so the document's publication date is used.

systems.platform: terrestrial fibre interconnection over the Central African Backbone
